summary: A set of tags the user can walk through and remove with the keyboard.

disabled.description: No tag can be removed or focused.

root.note: A row of tags that wraps. One remove control at a time is its Tab stop.

keys.ArrowRight / ArrowLeft: The remove control of the next or previous tag.
keys.Delete / Backspace: Asks the page to remove the focused tag.

events.remove: Dispatched when the user asks to remove a tag, by a press on its remove control or by Delete or Backspace. Its detail names the tag. The page removes it.

guidance.text: The author names the group with aria-label or aria-labelledby, and each remove control for what it removes.
The tags are the kit's tag recipe, each with a remove control. The page removes a tag when it hears `remove`; the group then moves focus to a neighbour.
